guide.title: App Guide
guide.welcome: Welcome! A quick tour of your sidebar:
guide.feed: Personalized rows ranked by your taste vector — Picked For You, Because You Watched, Hidden Gems and more.
guide.similars: Pick up to 5 films and get recommendations from their blended centroid.
guide.space: Your taste as an interactive 2-D map — explore your clusters and nearest films.
guide.groups: Enter Letterboxd or VectorBox handles to find films that fit everyone.
guide.watchlist: Your saved films, filterable by streaming availability.
guide.magic_box: Search by vibe, mood, director or era in plain language (⌘K).

about.title: About VectorBox
about.desc: Vector-based recommendation system powered by your Letterboxd data.
about.credits_tmdb: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
about.credits_justwatch: Streaming availability data provided by JustWatch via the TMDB API.
about.credits_omdb: Ratings data from the OMDb API, licensed under
about.credits_letterboxd: Thanks to Letterboxd for user-initiated rating imports. VectorBox is not affiliated with Letterboxd Ltd.

users.title: Manage Users & Uploads
users.subtitle: Select a user profile or create a new one to upload Letterboxd data.

why.title: Why upload data?
why.desc: Uploading your Letterboxd export allows our AI to learn your taste profile, recommend hidden gems, and find movies similar to your favorites.

how.title: How to export
how.desc: Go to Letterboxd Settings > Import & Export > Export Data. Download the zip file and drop it here.

sec_info.picked_for_you: The films your taste vector ranks highest right now — the trident engine's top picks.

sec_info.niche_picks: A rotating evocative theme, filtered to genre-coherent, well-rated films.
sec_info.hidden_gems: Critically loved films with a small audience that you likely missed.
sec_info.wildcard: An unexpected pick outside your usual clusters — discovery over precision.
sec_info.random_picks: A fresh random draw of highly-rated films from the catalogue.
